en: Dependent on a non-past state, a non-past state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine [conditions] in the case of root; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.
A non-past state is a condition for a non-past state by way of root condition. A non-past state is a condition for a future state by way of root condition.
A non-past state is a condition for a state that is both non-past and future by way of root condition.
A non-future state is a condition by way of root-cause for a non-future state. A non-future state is a condition by way of root-cause for a past state.
A non-future state is a condition by way of root-cause for both a past and a non-future state.
Dhammas that are neither past nor future are a condition, by way of root-condition, for a dhamma that is not past.
Dhammas that are neither past nor future are a condition, by way of root-condition, for a dhamma that is not future. [Dhammas] that are neither past nor future...
And states are related to past and future states by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: nine; under object: eighteen;
under predominance: eighteen ... pe ... under support: nine; under decisive support: eighteen; under prenascence ... pe ... under non-disappearance: nine.
